name: atlas-news-content
title: AI News — feed items and newsletter sources
description: The AI news feed as portable records: ranked, tagged and summarized news items, each with the quote its summary rests on, its review score and the run that wrote it; newsletter issues copied from the publisher's feed; one record per newsletter the feed follows; and the weekly Atlas Weekly issues assembled from the week's additions and feed. Content only — Markdown + JSON Schema + docs, zero code.
